oewn-01853188-v.learner: to move towards someone or something, or to get near to them.
examples: Make haste, and come down this moment.

oewn-02009962-v.learner: to get to the place you were travelling to.
examples: An express came at twelve last night, just as we were all gone to bed
just as the carriage came to the door, my uncle was called away upon business

oewn-00342572-v.learner: to happen, at the point when it was due to happen.

oewn-00022585-r.learner: to the same amount or level as something else.

oewn-00021214-r.learner: at no time in the past or the future, and not in any situation at all.

oewn-00034309-r.learner: after only a short time from now.

the attention of every lady was soon caught by a young man

oewn-00011555-r.learner: in a good, right or satisfying way, or to a high standard.

I am always glad to get a young person well placed out.
By now the danger was well understood.
The house was well hidden behind the trees.

oewn-00013554-r.learner: in a way that shows you think kindly of someone or something and approve of them.

oewn-01558587-s.learner: so great in degree or extent, or of the kind that has just been mentioned.

oewn-02076759-a.learner: not the one or the ones already named or already had in mind.

walking with an officer on the other side of the way

oewn-01735069-s.learner: belonging to a day or an evening a short time ago.

oewn-01733616-s.learner: belonging to a time long ago.

oewn-00028468-n.learner: the steady passing of everything that happens, from the future through the present into the past.

oewn-07324217-n.learner: one single occasion on which something happens.

oewn-15295388-n.learner: an amount of time that is yours to use and is enough to get something done.
